ADITHYAN R 
Phone: 9842265532 | Email: adithyan.r2024cce@sece.ac.in | GitHub: Adithyan R | LinkedIn: Adithyan R | Tamil Nadu 
SUMMARY 
Third-year CCE student at Sri Eshwar College of Engineering with hands-on experience in AI/ML systems, full-stack development, and data 
science. Passionate about building impactful real-world solutions in fraud detection, credit risk, vehicle health prediction, and agricultural 
tech. 
EDUCATION 
B.E Computer and Communication Engineering – Sri Eshwar College of Engineering || CGPA: 7.9 (upto 4th Sem) 2024 – 2028 
HSC – Srinivasa Vidhyalaya Matric Hr. Sec. School || 85.3% 2023 – 2024 
SSLC – Srinivasa Vidhyalaya Matric Hr. Sec. School || 84.6% 2021 – 2022 
INTERNSHIP EXPERIENCES 
RAMPeX2025 
Full Stack Development – Built and maintained full-stack web features, collaborating on end-to-end application development. 
Deloitte Australia2026 
Technology Job Simulation (Forage) – Completed practical tasks in coding and development, covering hands-on technology consulting 
exercises. 
PROJECTS 
TeamSync – AI-Powered Hackathon & Team Collaboration Platform2026 
Built a full-stack platform that discovers 466+ hackathons from multiple sources with India-wide location filtering, bookmarking, AI-powered 
team matching, and personalized hackathon recommendations. Developed complete team collaboration workflows includin g team creation, 
join requests, task assignment, submissions, evaluations, notifications, and an automated replacement-role system for when members 
leave. Implemented Groq-powered AI chatbot intent routing and deterministic skill-matching algorithms, with JWT authentication and a 
responsive Next.js interface. 
Tech: TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Groq AI, JWT, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs 
Notes Saver – Full-Stack Study Notes Platform for Students Worldwide2026 
Built a full-stack notes-saving platform enabling students worldwide to capture, organize, and revisit study notes from any device, 
integrating camera and microphone capture for scanning handwritten notes and recording voice notes, along with AI-powered features for 
summarization and smart organization. 
Tech: React/Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, WebRTC (Camera/Mic), AI APIs 
Crop Recommendation System2026 
Built an ML-based crop prediction system with 95%+ accuracy, integrating a live weather API and an NLP chatbot to deliver accessible 
recommendations to farming communities. 
Tech: Python, Scikit-Learn, FastAPI, Weather API, NLP 
VehicleIQ – AI Vehicle Health Monitoring & Breakdown Prediction2026 
Built an XGBoost + SHAP model for real-time breakdown prediction from sensor telemetry, integrating Twilio WhatsApp alerts and the 
Google Maps API for nearest service routing. Developed the solution as a full-stack application with a React/Next.js frontend and FastAPI 
backend, using MongoDB for storage, JWT authentication, and a live fleet health dashboard powered by LSTM/CNN time-series fault 
detection. 
Tech: Python, XGBoost, SHAP, LSTM, FastAPI, React/Next.js, MongoDB, Twilio, Google Maps API 
CERTIFICATIONS 
● The Complete Java Programmer: From Scratch to Advanced – Udemy (June 2026) 
● Concepts of Computer Networks – Udemy (June 2026) 
● Mastering Data Structures & Algorithms Using C and C++ – Udemy 
● Python Fundamentals – Infosys Springboard 
● Cloud Computing – NPTEL 
● Guidewire DEVTrails University Hackathon 2026 – Certificate of Participation (Guidewire & EY) 
● Expedia Group Hackathon – Participant 
 
CODING PROFILES 
LeetCode – Problems Solved: 130 | Global Rank: 15,60,370 | Profile: Adithyan R 
 
SKILLS 
Languages: C, C++, Python, Java, MySQL 
Web: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Next.js, FastAPI 
ML: XGBoost, SHAP, Isolation Forest, LSTM, Scikit-Learn, Regression, Classification, Feature Engineering 
Tools: VS Code, GitHub, Jupyter, MongoDB, Postman, Excel 
Core: OOP, DSA, DBMS, REST APIs, Computer Networks
